title: Body of army captain flown to New York | The Star
text: Body of army captain flown to New York | The Star × View Nation Body of army captain flown to New York Saturday, 02 Jan 2016 | 10:34 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Nation 28 Sep 2026 Tun Dr Siti Hasmah laid to rest World 26 Sep 2026 Congo military plane crash kills 13, including three officers, official says World 23 Sep 2026 Ukraine's army seeks to give frontline commanders more authority Kapt Hasman KUALA LUMPUR: The body of army captain Hasman Hussin (pic) , who died in the floods in Missouri, was flown to New York Saturday. The Army Headquarters in a statement said efforts to bring home the remains of the captain was underway after the completion of paperwork and other formalities at the morgue in Waynesville, Fort Leonard Wood at 11am Friday morning.
